content: Vedant Thakur inquires with insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari about the validity of the $71/month payment plan for his home policy (HP-001234) renewal. Ramesh confirms the plan is valid, notes that the upfront cost is $850, and confirms that the renewal deadline is today. Vedant decides to proceed with the renewal and asks Ramesh to guide him through the process.

action_items: Guide the customer through the policy renewal process
